run_bcq_atari: run the BCQ offline agent on Atari RL Unplugged datasets using absl flags for dataset path and game
build_make_network: build a DQN Atari network with image conversion and discrete action output using make_network
create_discrete_bcq_learner: create a DiscreteBCQLearner with a filtered Q network, dataset, learning rate, and discount factor
create_feedforward_actor: create a FeedForwardActor from an evaluator network for epsilon-greedy action selection in the environment
run_environment_loop: run an EnvironmentLoop with an actor, counter, and terminal logger to evaluate episodes periodically
